name: MacBook Pro M4 Max Llama-3.3-70B 8-bit decode (Silicon Score)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Silicon Score Llama 3.3 70B rows). 8-bit quant on ~546 GB/s unified memory; the 4-bit row on the same chip is 11.8 t/s (comm-apple-m4-max-llama33-70b-4bit-decode).
notes: 128GB MacBook Pro config. 8-bit 70B is marginal for interactive chat; this is a quality-vs-speed datapoint, not a reason to run 8-bit.
